qualification: Isolated TypedArray integrity dispatch on the committed shared-VM baseline; unrelated pending with binding, named-key, descriptor, backing, host and Wasm changes excluded and preserved.

representation.integrity: TypedArrays, proxies and module namespaces use the existing rooted SetIntegrityLevel/TestIntegrityLevel algorithms. Extensibility, ordered own keys, descriptors and definition behavior determine results; no second typed-view sealed/frozen state is introduced.
representation.effects: PreventExtensions precedes index definitions and their failures. Empty views process named and Symbol properties through the same operation. Descriptor queries derive sealed/frozen state from current indexed backing and named properties.
representation.reduction: Removed early typed freeze rejection, separate seal handling and typed queries through ordinary-object flags.

build.profile: release; correctness only, no performance claim

node_controls.scope: Four element kinds; empty/non-empty fixed views, proxies, fixed/tracking resizable views and detached views. Both normal and generic execution observe exceptions, identity, extensibility, integrity queries and descriptor side effects.

retained_differences.direct_proxy_query: Node reports the direct non-empty non-extensible view sealed while its transparent proxy is not sealed, despite configurable index descriptors. Quench uses the shared descriptor algorithm for both. The two former direct-query Node matches are deliberately lost under the pinned contract, not hidden.
retained_differences.partial_named_mutation: Node failed direct seal/freeze changes later named-property attributes; the shared algorithm encounters index-definition failure first and leaves those later properties unchanged.
retained_differences.detached_frozen_query: Node frozen classification uses stored view byte_length; detached own keys no longer contain indices. Quench derives frozen classification from current descriptors. This additional difference was initially in the ordinary group; all observations remain retained.
retained_differences.completion: These differences follow the pinned descriptor algorithm but remain compatibility differences. They do not prove frozen implemented Node suite completion.
